heroTitle: Wrinkles And Fine Lines: A Rested Look, Not A Frozen One
shortDesc: How expression lines, collagen loss and volume change age the face, and the stepwise treatments that soften them naturally.
intro: Fine lines around the eyes and forehead usually appear in the late twenties or thirties, earlier with sun exposure and smoking. Over time, repeated expressions etch dynamic lines into lasting creases, collagen and elastin thin out, and loss of fat and bone volume lets the face sag and fold. Indian skin tends to show pigmentation and dullness before wrinkles, and sagging later, so the plan differs from one copied from a Western clinic.

The goal at Skin Essence in Kalyani Nagar is a rested, natural look. Dr. Daksha Patel, whose special interests include anti-ageing and skin rejuvenation, builds treatment in steps: prevention first, then skin quality, then expression lines, volume and firmness, adding each only when it will make a visible difference.
causes: Repeated facial expressions such as frowning and squinting
Natural loss of collagen and elastin with age
Loss of fat and bone volume in the face, causing sagging and folds

howWeTreat.title: Prevention and skin quality
howWeTreat.description: Daily sunscreen, a retinoid and antioxidants, with peels or laser toning, improve texture and tone and protect everything that follows.

howWeTreat.title: Soften expression lines
howWeTreat.description: Botox relaxes the muscles behind frown lines, forehead lines and crow's feet. Doses are conservative, with a review at two weeks.

howWeTreat.title: Restore volume
howWeTreat.description: Hyaluronic acid fillers replace lost volume in the cheeks, under the eyes and around the mouth, placed for balance rather than size.

howWeTreat.title: Tighten and lift
howWeTreat.description: HIFU, a thread face lift or MNRF rebuilds collagen and firms a softening jawline and neck without surgery.

selfCare: Wear sunscreen daily; most visible ageing is sun damage.
Start a retinoid slowly, two or three nights a week.
Do not smoke, and sleep on your back if you can.
Keep weight stable; rapid loss ages the face.
whenToSeeDoctor: Lines are visible even when your face is at rest.
Cheeks look flatter or folds beside the mouth are deepening.
The jawline is softening or the neck is loosening.
You want a long-term plan rather than a one-off procedure.

faqs.q: At what age should I start anti-ageing treatment?
faqs.a: Sunscreen and a retinoid can start in the mid-twenties. Botox and fillers are considered when lines are visible at rest or volume loss is noticeable, usually from the thirties onwards, and only when they will make a real difference.

faqs.q: Will Botox make my face look frozen?
faqs.a: Not when the dose and injection points are chosen carefully by a dermatologist. The aim is to soften lines while keeping natural expression. Results last around 3 to 5 months.

faqs.q: Botox or fillers, which do I need?
faqs.a: Botox softens lines caused by muscle movement; fillers replace lost volume. Many patients need a little of one, some need both, and some need neither yet.

faqs.q: Are these treatments suitable for Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes. The main precaution is avoiding inflammation that triggers pigmentation, so peel strengths, laser settings and device energies are chosen with that in mind.
